input_messages.content: Hi! I recently bought a digital camera from your store, but it doesn’t zoom in as much as I was hoping. I use it mainly for bird-watching, so I really need something with the highest possible zoom. I’d like to exchange it for a model with the maximum zoom you have, but I want all the other features to stay the same. Can you help me with this? I’d like to get this sorted out as quickly as possible.
Sure, my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order—will my name and zip code be enough to find my account?

I don’t have the order ID handy right now. Is there another way you can look up my order, maybe by the date of purchase or the shipping address? Let me know what information you need and I’ll do my best to provide it.
The camera was shipped to my home address here in San Antonio, and I received it about two weeks ago. If you need the full shipping address, just let me know. Would that help narrow it down?

Yes, I’d like to exchange my current camera for the 10x zoom model with item ID 9228757377. That sounds perfect for what I need. For any price difference, I’d like to use my PayPal account. How soon can we get the exchange started?
Yes, that’s correct—I want to proceed with the exchange for the 10x zoom camera and use my PayPal account for any payment difference. Please go ahead and start the process.

Thank you so much for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the email with the return instructions. That’s all I needed for now. Have a great day!
